accounting.selected_share: sum selected CONTROL FFN timing / CONTROL decode-step timing, run-aligned
accounting.unselected_ffn_saving: sum(CONTROL unselected FFN - FAIR unselected FFN), run-aligned

stage_outcomes.OPERATOR_FAMILY_COLLATERAL_LIMITED: no system-relevant condition; GUD84 direct selected saving fraction >=2%; GUD84 material selected fraction >=0.50; GUD84 median OUTSIDE_FFN_RESIDUAL < 0
stage_outcomes.OPERATOR_FAMILY_NOT_SUPPORTED: no predeclared condition has positive whole-decode benefit beyond dispersion
stage_outcomes.OPERATOR_FAMILY_POSITIVE_BUT_SUBTHRESHOL: no higher-priority label; at least one condition has positive whole-decode benefit > combined dispersion
stage_outcomes.OPERATOR_FAMILY_SYSTEM_RELEVANT: any predeclared FAIR condition has >=2% whole-decode benefit and > combined dispersion
